try:
 v=s.xenapi.VM.get_record(s.xenapi.VM.get_by_uuid('2129a478-7bbb-b7f4-0f1a-425b3c5db45a'))
 out={'source':{'uuid':v['uuid'],'power_state':v['power_state']},'snapshots':[]}
 for r in v['snapshots']:
  x=s.xenapi.VM.get_record(r);d=s.xenapi.VDI.get_record(x['suspend_VDI'])
  out['snapshots'].append({'uuid':x['uuid'],'name':x['name_label'],'power_state':x['power_state'],'memory_vdi':d['uuid'],'memory_bytes':d['virtual_size']})
 print(json.dumps(out))
finally:s.xenapi.session.logout()

command:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes root@192.168.8.170 python3 - <<'PY'
import XenAPI,json
s=XenAPI.xapi_local();s.xenapi.login_with_password('','','1.0','storage-capability-read')
try:
 out=[]
 for r,v in s.xenapi.VM.get_all_records().items():
  if v['is_control_domain'] or v['power_state']!='Running':continue
  for b in v['VBDs']:
   b=s.xenapi.VBD.get_record(b)
   if b['type']!='Disk':continue
   d=s.xenapi.VDI.get_record(b['VDI']);sr=s.xenapi.SR.get_record(d['SR'])
   out.append({'vm':v['name_label'],'read_only':d['read_only'],'allowed':d['allowed_operations'],'storage_type':sr['type'],'vbd_mode':b['mode']})
 print(json.dumps(out))
finally:s.xenapi.session.logout()
